description.value: Cantaritos Mexican Grill is a full-service authentic Mexican restaurant in Burnaby serving classic dishes including enchiladas, chilaquiles, tortas ahogadas, and the namesake cantaritos cocktail. The restaurant offers dine-in, online ordering, catering, and private events, making it a sit-down destination rather than a quick stop. It sits on Kingsway, a busy arterial corridor through Burnaby.
